title: Notice Periods, Rent Increase Ceiling and Final Statement Timing (Assisted Living)
content:
**Exhibit to the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — periods and limits.** All periods are calendar days; the figures are the same at every care level.

| Term | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum written notice before a rent increase takes effect | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Ceiling on a single annual rent increase, percent of the rent in effect | 8.0 | 8.0 | 8.0 | 8.0 | 8.0 | 8.0 |
| Resident's written notice period of termination, from the notice date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days after the date of death through which rent and care fees continue | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Notice period on a move into a Larkspur memory care residence | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Written discharge notice when Larkspur ends a residency for nonpayment or because needs exceed assisted living | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days a charge may remain past due before a discharge notice for nonpayment may be issued | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Days after the vacate date by which the final statement is issued and any credit balance refunded | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

A hypothetical illustration of the ceiling: on a rent in effect of 4000.00, an 8.0 percent ceiling allows a new rent of at most 4320.00.
